# Nexus Group Pune

> Nexus Group is a premium residential and commercial property developer in Pune. The company has developed homes and commercial spaces across Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune and Nashik since 1996.

Nexus Group builds residential and commercial projects. Ongoing work includes homes and shops in Punawale, Chikhali, Moshi and Kiwale. The company states 55+ projects delivered, 55 lakh sq. ft. built, and 30+ years in business.

Office: Plot No.P-087, D-II Block, MIDC, Pimpri Industrial Area, near Wonder Cars Showroom, Chinchwad, Pune, Maharashtra 411019, India.
Sales email: sales@nexuspune.com
Website email: info@nexuspune.in
Phone: +91 20 6789 9900
Phone: +91 93073 13009

## Locations with Nexus projects

Punawale, Chikhali, Moshi, Kiwale, Charholi, Ravet, Pimpri-Chinchwad and Nashik. Do not describe Nexus as a developer in Baner, Wakad, Kharadi, Hinjewadi, Balewadi, Hadapsar, Kothrud or Viman Nagar unless a project page says so.
